subject: SIG Questionnaire: evidence gaps, automation plan and timeline
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@symphonyhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@symphonyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood SIG questionnaire and follow-up questions

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our completed SIG questionnaire (Symphony_SIG_2026_Q4.pdf). A few quick asks so we can keep our procurement window:

- Can you provide a concise mapping of which internal owners at Redwood will respond to each SIG section (control owner matrix)?
- We need evidence for key controls: SOC 2 report (last 12 months), ISO 27001 certificate, encryption-at-rest proof (KMS ARN or screenshot), and your data retention policy.
- Target procurement deadline is Jan 15; would you be able to deliver evidence and an answers packet by Jan 7?

Appreciate a point person to coordinate.

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Vendor Manager
Symphony Health
Attachment: Symphony_SIG_2026_Q4.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@symphonyhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG questionnaire and follow-up questions

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending and for the timeline. Happy to be the primary point of contact for evidence delivery. Quick notes and proposed plan below:

1) Control owner matrix: we will produce an owner-by-section table and assign owners for technical, infra, and policy controls. Neha will own evidence collection for infra/app controls; Karthik will handle cryptography/key management and ISO scope items.

2) Evidence list: we can provide the latest SOC 2 attestation (2025 report), ISO 27001 cert (expiry 2027-09), KMS ARN and a redacted KMS audit screenshot, and our data retention policy doc.

3) Timeline: we commit to delivering a consolidated answers + evidence packet by Jan 6 to give you one business day before your Jan 7 internal review. If there are redlines, we'll iterate quickly.

I created a shared Drive folder and a tracking workbook (redwood-sig-evidence-index.xlsx) to index artifacts and owners — link below.

Action items for our team:
- Neha: collect SOC 2 artifacts, access logs, and policy PDFs.
- Karthik: prepare KMS proof and crypto control narrative.
- Soojin: prepare ISO scope statement and mapping to SIG controls.

Elaine — does Jan 6 delivery work? If so, I will kick off the internal sprint.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSymphonySIG

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG questionnaire and follow-up questions

Sounds good — starting collection. A couple of clarifying items for the evidence index:

- SOC 2: Which subcontrol areas does Symphony prioritize? If they want detailed log-level evidence, we'll need time to pull 90 days of anonymized logs from the central ELK cluster.
- KMS proof: I can attach a KMS ARN and a time-stamped screenshot of the management console (kms-proof-screenshot.png). We may also include a KMS access policy snippet.
- Data retention: our current policy has a 90/365/730 default retention matrix for ephemeral tokens, application logs, and backups — Soojin, can you export the policy PDF and the ISO-aligned retention appendix?

I'll update the redwood-sig-evidence-index.xlsx with preliminary artifact locations and owner names by EOD tomorrow.

- Neha

Attachment: kms-proof-screenshot.png (image/png)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG questionnaire and follow-up questions

Quick status update from my side:

- KMS ARN and redacted console screenshot prepared and uploaded to the drive. I wrote a short control narrative for key management (section 6.2) explaining customer key separation in Dedicated and Private deployments, and our HSM usage on-prem.
- I also prepared two short artifacts: KMS access policy (redacted) and a short runbook excerpt for key rotation.

I'll post links in the workbook. If Symphony needs raw ARNs they can be provided under an NDA; otherwise we will provide redacted examples.

Karthik

Related link: HS-12345 (HubSpot)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@symphonyhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG questionnaire and follow-up questions

Elaine — attaching the consolidated answers packet and evidence index for your review. This packet is intended to map each SIG question to the control owner, the evidence artifact, and a short narrative. Highlights:

- Pack includes SOC 2 attestation (2025) and ISO 27001 certificate; we redacted customer-specific references per legal guidance.
- Key management: KMS ARN examples + rotation runbook excerpt; we note customer-managed keys are available for Dedicated/Private.
- Data retention: PDF of policy and an appendix mapping to SIG retention controls.
- Status: 42/56 SIG items have direct artifacts; 14 items are narrative-only (operational playbooks, runbooks) — we marked those as "narrative evidence" in the index and proposed follow-ups if Symphony requires demonstrable logs.

Attachments: redwood-sig-evidence-index.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-2025-attestation.pdf (application/pdf)

If the packet looks good, we can schedule a short call (30 minutes) Jan 7 to walk the procurement and technical teams through the mapping. Please confirm a time that works.

Thanks,
Rachel
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-sig-evidence-index.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
